key_insight: RS-MFBO cuts expensive simulation calls by combining sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization.
engineering_relevance: It helps optimize complex industrial process models faster and at lower computational cost without relying on a single high-fidelity simulator.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and keep only the most influential variables.
Fit a fidelity-aware Gaussian process to link cheap approximations with expensive simulations.
Drive sampling with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion mechanisms.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—a plasmid DNA bioprocess and a green fuel synthesis plant—and reduced high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the sensitivity reduction and the low-to-high fidelity correlation, which may be weak or problem-specific.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
